description: Fork of exp508 (hybrid: soft MatmulMHLut qk + argmax TinyMHLut v/out/residual, 1.4840). Two coupled changes to qk_lut: (1) HARDEN it from soft MatmulMHLut(softmax,AdamW) -> argmax TinyMHLut(soft backward) on LION, exactly like the other 3 modules -> fully matmul-free model again. (2) PARAM-MATCHED reshape: trade tph for nap, nap 6->2, tph 64->1024 (entries/table 2^nap*tph: 64*64 = 4*1024 = 4096, unchanged). Motivation: tests the row-coverage hypothesis on qk. NAP=2 = only 4 rows/table x 1024 tables; at bs=16 every row sees ~2048 tokens/batch (vs NAP=6's 64 starved rows). If hard argmax with great row coverage recovers exp508's soft-qk magnitude-leakage win, the soft apparatus is unnecessary on qk too. vs exp508 1.4840 (soft qk), exp475 1.4962 (all argmax ref), exp493 1.4806 (all soft).
